cited_by.title: Hair growth oils and supplements: castor, rosemary, black seed, biotin

record.population: 967 adults with alopecia or hair thinning, 14 studies
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of commercial oral supplements
record.finding: Branded supplements (such as Nutrafol and Viviscal) improved anagen hair density against placebo, but total hair count showed no significant difference (p=0.06). The authors say more rigorous, independent research is needed.
record.note: Branded products; participants not selected for afro hair; independence of trials not checked.
